sql: SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC) AS rank_v, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY v DESC) AS dense_v FROM (VALUES (1, 20), (2, 20), (3, 10)) AS t(id, v) ORDER BY id
SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY (id % 2) ORDER BY v DESC, id) AS rn FROM (VALUES (1, 5), (2, 6), (3, 7), (4, 2)) AS t(id, v) ORDER BY id
